title: lantana microphylla
intro: Lantana microphylla, commonly known as Dwarf Lantana or Small-leaf Lantana, is a shrub-like flowering plant native to the Americas. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Lantana microphylla include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve immune function, while its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, contribute to its medicinal properties and antioxidant activity. Furthermore, the plant has been traditionally used to treat skin conditions, wounds, and gastrointestinal issues, making it a valuable resource in folk medicine.
